The House

The Olive Tree House is an authentic countryside home in Liapades, set on the first floor and opening towards views on both sides.

Natural light moves through the house throughout the day, reflecting off the wooden ceilings and connecting the interior with the balconies.

The house has two bedrooms, one bathroom, an open-plan living, dining and kitchen area, and two balconies.

It comfortably accommodates four guests. A fifth guest may occasionally be accommodated on request.

A calm double bedroom with a king-size bed, a wooden ceiling and generous storage.

French doors open towards the meadow to the east, while a west-facing window brings in light from the opposite side of the house.

Living, dining and kitchen

The kitchen, dining area and sitting room share one continuous open-plan space.

The kitchen is fully equipped for everyday cooking, while the living area connects naturally with both balconies.

A bright, practical bathroom with a bathtub and shower, washing machine and illuminated mirror.

East Balcony · Meadow View

The east balcony looks across the meadow and the green hills beyond.

It is the place for early coffee, first light and slow mornings.

West Balcony · Park View

The west balcony faces the mature trees and village park beside the house.

In the late afternoon, the sunset filters through the trees and the balcony becomes a natural place to enjoy the last light of the day.
